items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: Yeah, Del P owned the place.

ctx.x: Was there an owner, somebody ran the club?
Yeah, Del P owned the place. That was the guy's name? That was the guy's name. That's why they called it Del P's. Del P's. And them that didn't know his name was C. Caliokin Franklin.
Oh, so it was sort of a pseudonym for the club. Yeah, it was in between, yeah. Well, did, so that was the hangout spot?
